sources.title: Federal Reserve — SR26-2: Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management (17 April2026)
sources.verification: Official letter body opened and read. Supersedes SR11-7 and SR21-8; applicability language says expected to be most relevant to Fed-regulated banking organizations above $30b. Do not present older SR11-7 as current guidance.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Regulatory Service — Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk Management (interagency17 April2026)
sources.verification: Actual official body SectionsI–VII and footnotes read. Risk-based/tailored guidance, not enforceable prescriptive standards; materiality, challenge, development/use, validation/outcomes/monitoring, governance and third-party models. Simple arithmetic/no-theory deterministic processes excluded from definition; generative/agentic AI excluded by footnote3. Model-governance chapter must preserve these scoped distinctions without legal compliance certification.
